Help and version succeed offline. Bare or unknown commands exit nonzero.
No database, configuration or evidence files are created by these invocations.

`bind` registers/maps/imports; `settle` declares lifecycle, imports normalized evidence or computes;
`explain` inspects/exports and reports repository remainder. `quote` computes offline empirical estimates. `check` compares explicit historical records to compatible budgets, with valid unknown advice. `settle --import-codex` imports only the exact approved finite diagnostic snapshot. `settle --import-claude-project` imports approved 2.1.215 project and exact Desktop 2.1.308 root terminal diagnostics. Neither grants demand or financial authority.
